title: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis
why_read: A screen-reading chat-assistance tool for messaging apps that suggests replies, of narrow interest and light on technical novelty.
analysis: This is a mobile tool that reads on-screen chat content in apps like QQ, X, and Feishu, then suggests candidate replies the user can insert manually, explicitly marketed as non-invasive and not modifying the host apps. The technical approach, screen scraping plus LLM-based reply suggestion, is a common pattern with not much novel engineering to highlight. Its popularity likely stems from being genuinely useful to end users in a specific regional messaging ecosystem rather than any technical breakthrough. It is a legitimate assistive productivity tool, not something that should be excluded, but it's not particularly noteworthy from an engineering standpoint.
